        blueprint: "Blueprint",
        app: "Flask",
        options: t.Any,
        first_registration: bool,

        #: a reference to the current application
        self.app = app

        self.blueprint = blueprint

        #: :meth:`~flask.Flask.register_blueprint` method.

        #: application and not everything wants to be registered

def test_nested_blueprint_names(app):
    parent = flask.Blueprint("parent", __name__)
    child = flask.Blueprint("child", __name__)

    @child.route("/")
    def index():
        return "Child"

    parent.register_blueprint(child, url_prefix="/child")
    app.register_blueprint(parent, url_prefix="/parent")

    assert app.blueprints == {"parent": parent, "parent.child": child}
    assert parent.name == "parent"
    assert child.name == "child"
    assert "parent.child.index" in app.view_functions
    adapter = app.url_map.bind("localhost")
    assert adapter.build("parent.child.index", {}) == "/parent/child/"
    assert adapter.match("/parent/child/") == ("parent.child.index", {})
